_meta.seam_derivation: Transferred from vertical IG5_F1XXX_1FRM_1SSH.json SSH_EXT/SSH_INT seam, using verified (0, +41.0) translation between vertical and horizontal profile coordinate frames (confirmed via GSK_SSH_EXT gasket bbox match to <0.02 units).

_meta.post_seam_derivation: Transferred from vertical IG5_F1XXX_1FRM_1SSH.json FRM_EXT/FRM_INT seam (the post profile is the same extrusion as the frame, nested under słupek 01). Seam located by finding the longest single edge in each closed contour (the synthetic straight cut line added when the source CAD separated the dual-color halves), averaged across both contours: top (35.0, 41.0), bottom (35.0, 7.0) in vertical-frame local coords. Applied the same verified (0, +41.0) translation as the sash seam. Nearest-point match on the 109-pt post loop: 0.38mm residual (looser than the sash match because the seam coordinate itself was only known to ~1mm precision in the source drawing, not because the transform is wrong).
